question: Which of these companies will have the highest rank among their group on CompaniesMarketCap on December 28, 2026?

calls.reasoning: CMC (Nov 25 close data): SpaceX #7 $1.730T, Meta #9 $1.559T, Tesla #10 $1.502T, BRK #13 $1.230T, Anthropic #14 $1.106T. Status quo SpaceX leads by ~11% (Meta) and ~15% (Tesla) with ~21 trading days left. SpaceX is extremely volatile (post-IPO range $1.51T-$2.44T, -14% last month, -7.7% and -5.65% days), with the Dec 8 lockup expiry (~798M shares) and the Dec 9 Arizona campus vote ahead, so a random-walk spread model gives Meta/Tesla a combined ~40% chance of overtaking. Tesla gets a bump from the SpaceX-Tesla merger talks: Polymarket ~21% / Kalshi 10-15% for an announcement by year-end, and a Tesla-favorable exchange ratio would tie TSLA's price to SPCX at a premium. Anthropic (IPO Nov 19, falling) needs a big rally or a CMC share-count update; BRK is a deep tail. Market check: no Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold contract on this five-company group; the Polymarket 'largest company end of Dec 2026' market (NVDA/AAPL favored, SpaceX/Tesla <1%) is a near-miss, not an anchor.
